race.comment: CICALA (7) had a very tough trip in the Murray Bridge Cup nearly 3 weeks ago, and she did not give it up, fighting on bravely to finish seventh. She will be looking for some luck again, but is more than capable of winning this, especially on a wet track. BAMYAN BUDDHA (5) sat close to the pace in the Murray Bridge Cup, and loomed large before peaking late to finish third. He will be spot on for this, but will have to overcome a very wide gate. Include in all top 4 combos. SIR KINGSFORD (4) set the pace in the Murray Bridge Cup, and was only bloused right on the line, finishing runner-up by a nose. He too has come unstuck with a wide gate, but if he can find the front again, then he will take some pegging back. SAV ON ICE (2) won the Balaklava Cup in his penultimate start, but failed to fire in the Murray Bridge Cup, where a wide gate did him no favours. He is drawn closer in this time, and can make amends. BOOTLEGGER (3) is looking for a chance of luck and should be kept safe.
